ImageDescription.value: Aerial photograph of the campus of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, taken by the United States Department of War. Facing north, the Main Group and Great Dome are in the center of the image. At center right are E18 and E19, completed in 1920. At middle left are buildings of MIT's Military Aeronautics program, now demolished. In the background is the industrial district of Cambridge, now known as Kendall Square.
